appearance.prePaint: The theme script runs before the stylesheet link, so the first painted frame already matches the stored or system preference.

table.captionText: Documented capability comparison between Cyron and four other Windows utilities. A documented feature is not proof that it works on this machine, and no competitor timing was measured.

limitations: The skip-link reveal and focus ring were not visually confirmed in the headless preview because document focus and transition frames did not apply; the CSS :focus-visible and .skip-link:focus hooks are present.
No screen reader was run. Accessible names and heading order were read from the live DOM.
The product screenshots are light UI; dark mode dims them rather than showing a dark application theme, which does not exist yet.
